summary: Large sports-ground car park, south edge against the oval, homes across the road.

best_section.where: South edge of the sports car park, beside the oval and water tank

drivers.seclusion: Playing fields and club buildings to the south; houses sit across Hepworth Street, well over 25 m from this edge.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed car park with marked bays, open to the street at the west end; plenty of room.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street along the north; bays are off the lane.
drivers.convention: Cars park there; Saturday 8am-4pm no-parking signs are daytime only.

flags: Saturday 8am-4pm no parking: leave early on Saturdays
Sloping: 7% mean grade over the whole outline, about 3% on the best section
Club events and training at weekends and evenings
sun_shade: Open to sun; trees shade the east end and south-west corner, morning shade from the east.
